proof_body:
by
  intro S a c h hc
  constructor
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h.1 hx) hc.le
  · intro b hb
    have h1 : a ≤ b / c := h.2 (fun x hx => by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hc, mul_comm]
      exact hb ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hc, mul_comm] at h1
    exact h1
target_source: ∀ (S : Set ℝ) (a c : ℝ), IsLUB S a → 0 < c → IsLUB ((fun x => c * x) '' S) (c * a)
